meta.name: Momentum Orbit
meta.note: Single source of truth. A token with a "css" key becomes that CSS custom property in src/styles/tokens.css (npm run design:tokens). Never declare these properties by hand.

subtle.description: Grouped background below opaque content surfaces

auraPrimary.description: Noninformational saffron environment aura; never carries state

auraEnergy.description: Noninformational coral environment aura; never carries state

splashGlow.description: Glow behind the boot splash mark; never carries state

content.description: Default opaque reading, plan, form, and card surface

raised.description: Selected or elevated opaque content surface

sunken.description: Input well and chart plotting surface

glassRegular.description: Adaptive translucent tint for regular functional Liquid Glass

glassProminent.description: More separated translucent tint for prominent functional Liquid Glass

glassClear.description: Minimal-tint Clear glass for a bounded media or aura backdrop with an explicit local legibility treatment

glassInteractionPrimary.description: Localized ink optical response during interaction or selection; never a full-screen overlay

glassInteractionEnergy.description: Brief localized coral interaction highlight; never a persistent primary-action fill

glassFallback.description: Opaque fallback for every glass material when transparency is unavailable or reduced

hover.description: Pointer hover fill for secondary, ghost and row controls

glassHighlight.description: Specular top-left highlight of Liquid Glass

glassLowlight.description: Bottom inner shade of Liquid Glass

glassCore.description: Core fill of Liquid Glass materials

glassTint.description: Optional colored sheen inside glass gradients; transparent by default

tertiary.description: Nonessential metadata; never the only presentation of required information

inverse.description: Text over fixed inverse or protected media surfaces

primary.description: Ink fill for the one primary action per view

primaryHover.description: Pointer hover fill for the primary action

primaryPressed.description: Pressed fill for the primary action

onPrimary.description: Foreground over all primary action states

secondary.description: Low-emphasis saffron action or selected-control fill

secondaryHover.description: Pointer hover fill for low-emphasis actions

onSecondary.description: Foreground over low-emphasis saffron action fill

link.description: Inline and standalone link foreground; underline remains available for context

primary.description: Saffron tint: monthly plan identity, selection, and food; not an AI-chat identity

strong.description: Hover and pressed saffron for links and selected states

onPrimary.description: Text on a solid saffron fill

primary.description: Coral: training and milestone accent; never a default CTA

warning.description: Caution or state needing review foreground

warningSoft.description: Caution or state needing review background

warningBorder.description: Caution or state needing review boundary

danger.description: Destructive, failed, or critical state foreground

dangerSoft.description: Destructive, failed, or critical state background

dangerBorder.description: Destructive, failed, or critical state boundary

control.description: Control and field boundary with at least 3:1 graphical contrast

strong.description: High-emphasis boundary and Increased Contrast replacement

glass.description: Single optical highlight boundary for functional glass

ring.description: Focus indicator with a surface-colored separation gap when adjacent to a primary action

series1.description: Chart series one; pair with solid line and circle marker

series2.description: Chart series two; pair with dashed line and square marker

series3.description: Chart series three; pair with dotted line and diamond marker

series4.description: Chart series four; pair with dash-dot line and triangle marker

series5.description: Chart series five; pair with long-dash line and cross marker

series6.description: Chart series six; pair with short-dash line and plus marker; does not imply danger without a status label

gridline.description: Chart grid line; never carries a data value

referenceLine.description: Labeled chart reference or target line

unknown.description: Missing or unknown data: dashed outline, never a zero-height bar

food.description: Meals: rings, legend dots, meal series

training.description: Workouts: rings, legend dots, training series

water.description: Water: ring, legend dot and water card only

orbitTrack.description: Faint orbit track inside the mark

surface.description: Surface the inline OrbitMark tile is filled with

border.description: Printed report rules and table borders

control.description: Buttons, inputs, selects, menu items, segments

inset.description: Notices, segmented controls, menus and containers nested in a card

chrome.description: Navigation bars and large hero media

mono.description: Machine identifiers and diagnostic values only

digits.description: Vazirmatn limited to digits, percent and separators by unicode-range; prefixed to every stack so numbers always render in Vazirmatn

display.description: Landing hero only; marketing pages may scale it fluidly with clamp()

footnote.description: Field labels, legend rows, secondary lines

caption.description: Smallest text: pills, hints, timestamps. Nothing smaller exists

display.description: Latin display tightening; Persian never takes letter-spacing

label.description: Latin label spacing; Persian never takes letter-spacing

lead.description: Intro paragraph under a marketing hero

title.description: App page titles (one per page) and onboarding titles

hero.description: Marketing hero headline, one per page

2.description: Sticky functional chrome, floating toolbar, or popover

glassRegular.description: Default Liquid Glass for navigation, compact toolbars, popovers, and temporary controls only

glassProminent.description: More separated Liquid Glass for a hierarchy-critical floating control or platform-conventional action surface; never a content card

glassClear.description: Minimal-tint functional Liquid Glass for a controlled media or aura backdrop; requires an explicit local dimming or contrast treatment

glassFallback.description: Required opaque replacement for Liquid Glass under Reduced Transparency, unsupported blur, unknown contrast, print, or performance policy

overlay.description: Opaque dialog and blocking overlay material

glassMorph.description: Menus opening, chevrons, glass shape changes

narrow.description: Below this: small phones; stack side-by-side pairs

expanded.description: medium < 840 ≤ expanded: sidebar replaces the bottom bar

pageGutter.description: Page side gutter per window class

minimum.description: Touch target on every platform; a small icon never means a small target

bottomBarMinHeight.description: Bottom bar height before safe-area inset

minHeight.description: Minimum monthly plan status control height

maxWidth.description: Monthly plan status maximum reading width

width.description: One ring on every focusable element; 3:1 against every surface it lands on

insetOffset.description: Ring drawn inside items clipped by their container (bottom bar, list options)

sm.description: Icon inside a button or row

md.description: Icon tile in a list row

glowPlan.description: Saffron lift under the splash mark while loading completes

sticky.description: Sticky headers and summary rails inside the page

nav.description: App bottom bar, sidebar, public header

banner.description: Persistent bottom banners such as the update card; stays under menus and sheets

modal.description: Dialogs, sheets, the open public menu

toast.description: Connectivity and confirmation toasts; above sheets
